patterns: APPSC asks single-fact place questions: first sermon = Sarnath, death = Kusinagara; match birth-enlightenment-sermon-death places is the staple.
Other PSCs recycle: Mahaparinirvana in Malla kingdom/Kushinagar, women admitted at Vaishali, Alara Kalama = teacher, Subhadda = last convert, Mahakassapa presided First Council at Rajgir.
Traps: Kapilavastu vs Lumbini for birth, Bodh Gaya on Niranjana, Buddha named no successor, Devadatta wanted to lead the Sangha, Light of Asia based on Lalitavistara.
Doctrinal items are shallow: Nirvana = extinction of desire, order of Four Noble Truths, Avidya causes Samskara.
App adds many multi-statement and match items on Sangha terms, donors, Ashtamahasthanas and current affairs that go deeper than APPSC's direct one-liners.
